We need to fill to full. So we need to add 50 - current gallons. But we only know liters. We need to convert liters to gallons. 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. So 10 liters = 2.6417 gallons. So remaining capacity = 50 - 2.6417 = 47.3583 gallons. So call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount ~47.36 gallons.
